object:stamped / mail.visualDescription: PixelHack shows a short rolled tan parchment with a dark outer wrap and a bright red wax-like stamp on its face. It differs from the shared magic-scroll image. The teal floor pattern is background.
object:stamped / mail.wikiDescription: The NetHack Wiki identifies a scroll of mail as non-magical mail rather than a spell scroll. The stamped appearance is the visible cue in this atlas.
object:stamped / mail.modelBrief: Build a separate small rolled mail scroll with dark brown outer curl and a visible red seal. Keep it distinct from the shared tan magic-scroll model.

object:unlabeled / blank paper.wikiDescription: The NetHack Wiki describes blank paper as a non-magical scroll that can be written on. The unlabeled appearance and lack of marks are the model cues.
object:unlabeled / blank paper.modelBrief: Build a separate thin curled blank sheet with a clean pale face and no magical runes or red stamp.

object:parchment / dig.visualDescription: PixelHack shows a thick closed book lying diagonally, with a parchment-tan cover with worn ochre flecks, rough pale page edges, and a dark lower spine. Its exposed page block is cream-colored, and the teal floor pattern is background.
object:parchment / dig.wikiDescription: The NetHack Wiki describes the spellbook of dig as a book that teaches the dig spell. The parchment cover is an atlas appearance that can shuffle between games; the visible binding does not identify the spell by itself.
object:parchment / dig.modelBrief: Build the shared thick closed-book form with pale page block and worn tan parchment with small ochre speckles. Keep the diagonal cover silhouette and 32-pixel legibility; do not add spell-specific symbols to this randomized appearance.
